name: stackscope
description: A local-first browser extension for detecting webpage technologies and languages.

scripts.validate: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json', 'utf8')); console.log('manifest.json is valid')" && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node --check injected.js && node --check techIcons.js && node --check background.js
